repos_data.description: Amazon ElastiCache Cluster Client is an enhanced PHP library to connect to ElastiCache clusters. This client library has been built upon libmemcached and is released under the Apache License.
Libmemcached library support for Amazon ElastiCache Memcached Cluster for PHP. The client is available at https://github.com/awslabs/aws-elasticache-cluster-client-memcached-for-php.
A configuration object for Enyim's MemcachedClient that enables the use of Amazon ElastiCache's Auto Discovery feature
A Binary Memcached client for Go with support for sharding using consistent hashing, along with SASL.

Sample code for a java application that uses Elastic Beanstalk, S3, DynamoDB, and SQS to create a meme generation website and processing pipeline.  For a demonstration of the application in action, see this talk from AWS re:Invent 2012: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YeRNErD81VA
Extensible Node.js library for the Amazon Web Services API
ARCHIVED: Amazon DynamoDB based session store for Apache Tomcat
